elements.name: wavedash.upload_leaderboard_score_async

elements.name: wavedash.is_entitled_async
elements.description: Returns whether the player owns the given paid content. This is a UX hint, not a security check — Wavedash re-verifies ownership when serving the paid files. This is an asynchronous function. The result will be delivered as an event with id 'isEntitled' or as a return value if the function is called from a coroutine.

returnvalues.name: response
returnvalues.doc:
Returns whether the player owns the content in data. (Note:
Only if called from within a coroutine)

elements.name: wavedash.get_entitlements_async
elements.description: Returns every paid content identifier the player owns for this game. This is a UX hint, not a security check — Wavedash re-verifies ownership when serving the paid files. This is an asynchronous function. The result will be delivered as an event with id 'getEntitlements' or as a return value if the function is called from a coroutine.

returnvalues.name: response
returnvalues.doc:
Returns the owned content identifiers in data. (Note: Only
if called from within a coroutine)

elements.name: wavedash.trigger_paywall_async
elements.description: Open the Wavedash paywall for the given paid content. Resolves immediately with data true if the player already owns it; otherwise resolves with whether the purchase completed. Handle the purchase itself in the PurchaseCompleted event, which also covers purchases made outside the game. This is an asynchronous function. The result will be delivered as an event with id 'triggerPaywall' or as a return value if the function is called from a coroutine.

returnvalues.name: response
returnvalues.doc:
Returns whether the purchase completed in data. (Note: Only
if called from within a coroutine)

elements.name: wavedash.get_unfulfilled_purchases_async
elements.description: Consumable purchases the game hasn't fulfilled, oldest first, each shaped like the PurchaseCompleted payload. These already arrive as PurchaseCompleted events at launch, but each purchase fires once per session: use this to retry one whose fulfill_purchase_async call failed. This is an asynchronous function. The result will be delivered as an event with id 'getUnfulfilledPurchases' or as a return value if the function is called from a coroutine.

returnvalues.name: response
returnvalues.doc:
Returns the unfulfilled purchases in data. (Note: Only if
called from within a coroutine)

elements.name: wavedash.fulfill_purchase_async
elements.description: Mark a consumable purchase fulfilled once the grant is saved, so it stops being redelivered. A game's backend can do the same with POST /api/purchases/{purchaseId}/fulfill and the purchase's receiptJwt; both are idempotent, so calling either or both is safe. Resolves with a status in data: FULFILLED, ALREADY_FULFILLED (also success), or NOT_FOUND (unknown or refunded: don't grant it). This is an asynchronous function. The result will be delivered as an event with id 'fulfillPurchase' or as a return value if the function is called from a coroutine.

returnvalues.name: response
returnvalues.doc:
Returns { status } in data. (Note: Only if called from
within a coroutine)

elements.name: wavedash.EVENT_ENTITLEMENTS_GRANTED
elements.brief: Deprecated: handle EVENT_PURCHASE_COMPLETED instead, which also covers consumables.
elements.description: Deprecated: handle EVENT_PURCHASE_COMPLETED instead, which also covers consumables.

elements.name: wavedash.EVENT_PURCHASE_COMPLETED
elements.brief: Fired once per purchase made while the game is running (in-game paywall, game page, gift, another tab), plus, at launch, once per consumable still unfulfilled. Payload: { purchaseId, contentIdentifier, type, fulfilled, purchasedAt, receiptJwt }. Durables arrive with fulfilled true, already granted. For a consumable, grant it, then call fulfill_purchase_async(purchaseId); until then it's redelivered every launch, so dedupe on purchaseId if you persist grants.
elements.description: Fired once per purchase made while the game is running (in-game paywall, game page, gift, another tab), plus, at launch, once per consumable still unfulfilled.
